issue_context.title: ESQL: keep after stats can lead to non-aggregating query
issue_context.body:
Consider the query
```
              FROM test
              | STATS by emp_no
              | EVAL x = 1
              | KEEP x
```
This should return a row (with the value `x = 1`) for _each unique value of `emp_no`_.

Instead, it returns one row for each document in `test`.

Inspecting the optimized logical plan shows why (to repro, add as test to `LogicalPlanOptimizerTests.java`):
```
EsqlProject[[x{r}#4]]
\_Eval[[1[INTEGER] AS x]]
  \_Limit[1000[INTEGER]]
    \_EsRelation[test][_meta_field{f}#12, emp_no{f}#6, first_name{f}#7, ge..]
```
The `EsRelation` at the root is wrong, instead there has to be a logical plan that produces the number of unique `emp_no` values. (`Aggregation` can do this.)
